description: Header file defining the BreakpadController class, which manages crash reporting via Breakpad on iOS. It provides methods for configuration, starting/stopping crash handlers, and uploading crash reports.

classes.name: BreakpadController
classes.description: Objective-C class managing crash reporting with Breakpad on iOS, providing configuration, control, and report upload functionalities.

methods.name: sharedInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of BreakpadController.

methods.name: updateConfiguration
methods.description: Merges and updates the crash report configuration.

methods.name: setUploadingURL
methods.description: Sets the URL for crash report uploads.

methods.name: setUploadInterval
methods.description: Sets the interval between crash report uploads.

methods.name: setParametersToAddAtUploadTime
methods.description: Adds server parameters for crash report uploads.

methods.name: withBreakpadRef
methods.description: Executes a callback with the BreakpadRef, asynchronously.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts crash handling, registering crash handlers.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops crash handling, unregistering crash handlers.

methods.name: setUploadingEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables crash report uploading.

methods.name: hasReportToUpload
methods.description: Checks if there is a crash report pending upload.

methods.name: getCrashReportCount
methods.description: Retrieves the count of crash reports waiting to upload.

methods.name: getNextReportConfigurationOrSendDelay
methods.description: Retrieves the next report configuration or delay before sending.

methods.name: threadUnsafeSendReportWithConfiguration
methods.description: Sends a crash report synchronously; must be called from the breakpad thread.
